description: A person with chronic migraines has been tracking symptoms for 3 weeks but the data is messy and scattered. Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/migraine_notes_raw.xlsx containing raw notes. Create a structured symptom tracking log with proper columns (Date, Migraine, Severity, Sleep Hours, Caffeine, Stress, Screen Time). Clean and transfer at least 15 days of data. Add analysis formulas to calculate: total migraine count, average severity when migraines occur, and comparison statistics (average sleep on migraine vs non-migraine days). Format professionally for medical presentation.
